_help: The owner's details for the Terms, Privacy and Refund pages (/terms, /privacy, /refunds).
Fill in a value, then run: node apps/customer-site/scripts/build-legal-pages.mjs
An empty value is left out of the pages cleanly (no [brackets] are ever shown).
The phone number is used only inside the Call us / WhatsApp us links, never shown as text (owner, 2026-10-15).
lastUpdated is the date shown on all three pages and in sitemap.xml (YYYY-MM-DD).
